specs: Must be atleast 7 years old and 55” tall.
Children between the ages of 7-9 must be accompanied by a climbing participant at least 18 years of age who will act as the child’s guardian for the length of the activity.
Must be at least five years of age to participate.
Reminders Participants will get wet and MUST be able to swim.
Journey to Frog Rock: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Willow Cove Expedition: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Everything you bring with you must be packed out so bring extra trash bags.
Portable potty bags (WAG Bags) must be used and disposed of along with your trash.
A waiver/release of liability must be signed, and any emergency services will be at the renters’ expense.

blurb: Explore Catalina Island's natural beauty with kayaking, stand-up paddleboard, snorkeling and boat-in camping equipment rentals at Descanso Beach. We offer a variety of rental options to enhance your water adventures, including hourly and daily single or double kayak rentals, and stand-up paddleboards (SUP) rentals.
